quote: Proposition 2.I: Let F1(x; α, β, θ) and G1(x; α, β, θ) be the cdfs of the EPAD and EWD, each with parameters α, β and θ. Then F1(x; α, β, θ) ≤ G1(x; α, β, θ). That is the EPAD(α, β, θ) exhibits first-order stochastic dominance over the EWD(α, β, θ).
